A piece of text you pay for. It also fills the window.

Model + instructions + tools + memory + a loop.

Rules in separate files. Some apply only to given paths
A folder with SKILL.md: a trigger description plus
instructions, loaded when needed. A recipe, not a request.
A command run on an event, before or after an action. Exit
allow / ask / deny. Deny beats allow.
Tasks with the expected result written first, run several times.
A test paper for the AI.
A standard for plugging in outside tools with typed calls.
A plugin packs extensions. A mod is a plugin of JS/TS
handlers that run inside Claude Code. Official, not used here.
